Lionel Messi scored for an eighth straight World Cup match as Argentina survived a huge scare against Cabo Verde.  (Getty Images: Jussi Eskola)

Lionel Messi has scored for an eighth straight World Cup game as Argentina survived a massive scare against Cabo Verde to advance to the Round of 16.

The reigning World Cup champions were pushed to extra time after Messi's first-half opener was cancelled out by Deroy Duarte.

Lisandro Martinez restored Argentina's lead, only for the South American side to be pegged back once more courtesy of a stunning goal from Sidny Lopes Cabral.

However, the Cabo Verde fairytale eventually came to an end after an own goal from Diney Borges in the 111th minute gave Argentina a 3-2 lead it would not relinquish.

Elsewhere on Saturday, Australia's World Cup campaign came to a heartbreaking end after losing to Egypt on penalties, while Colombia advanced to the last 16 courtesy of a 1-0 win over Ghana with Jhon Arias scoring the winner.

Follow the live blog below for a recap of all of Saturday's World Cup action as it happened.

Sat 4 Jul 2026 at 2:02pm

By Chris De Silva

That's it for today's FIFA World Cup action after another trio of incredible matches!

Egypt, Argentina and Colombia stay alive and book their tickets to the last 16, while the Socceroos are sent packing.

Please join us tomorrow morning as the Round of 16 gets underway with Canada's clash against Morocco.

See you then!

Key Event

Sat 4 Jul 2026 at 1:32pm

By Chris De Silva

There it is!

Colombia is through to the Round of 16 of the FIFA World Cup after a 1-0 win over Ghana courtesy of Jhon Arias's first-half strike.

It was a professional display from the South American side in Kansas City, even if it wasn't always fluent.

Ghana's World Cup journey comes to an end and unfortunately they just could not create enough clear-cut chances tonight against a very disciplined Colombian side.

Colombia finished the match with 61 per cent possession and 532 accurate passes to Ghana's 312.

The Colombians also had 20 shots on goal, including eight on target and will probably feel like they should've scored more than the solitary goal tonight.

Nevertheless, they've got it done and they've now put together three straight clean sheets after conceding in their World Cup opener against Uzbekistan.

There will be some questions over the status of veteran skipper James Rodriguez, who was substituted at half-time. It'll be interesting to see whether that was due to an injury or simply some good old load management.

Colombia will now face Switzerland in the Round of 16 with the bracket for that stage of the tournament complete.

Sat 4 Jul 2026 at 1:30pm

By Chris De Silva

Colombia certainly not looking to waste time out here despite holding the lead.

They're firing at the goal at will, but Lawrence Ati-Zigi is on hand to deny them two more times.

Time running out for Ghana unfortunately. There must be only seconds left before the referee blows for full time.

Sat 4 Jul 2026 at 1:28pm

By Chris De Silva

Juan Quintero whips another one into the box and this time Lawrence Ati-Zigi is there to punch it away.

Good commanding goalkeeping that time from Ghana's man between the sticks.

Sat 4 Jul 2026 at 1:27pm

By Chris De Silva

Juan Quintero puts in another delicious ball and this time it's towards Richard Ríos.

Ríos looks to head the ball into goal, but he ends up headbutting Ghanaian defender Gideon Mensah instead and the ball trickles out of play.

Quintero's delivery on these balls is something to behold.

Sat 4 Jul 2026 at 1:24pm

By Chris De Silva

Luis Díaz is replaced by Jaminton Campaz as we tick into stoppage time in the second half.

The fourth official holds up the board and we're going to have six added minutes.

Sat 4 Jul 2026 at 1:22pm

By Chris De Silva

It's been an incredibly frustrating night for Antoine Semenyo, and it's shown here.

Semenyo finds himself in close quarters with Gustavo Puerta in the midst of a strong attack from Ghana and flings Puerta to the ground just as one of his teammates fired a shot on goal.

The shot goes wide, thankfully for Semenyo. He'd have hated to see a goal chalked off for such a petulant act.

The Manchester City man has been a little disappointing today, I must say.

Sat 4 Jul 2026 at 1:19pm

By Chris De Silva

WHAT A HIT FROM JUAN QUINTERO!

He's got an absolutely brilliant left boot on him and unleashes a rasping shot on goal from outside the box, but it flies just wide of the right-hand upright.

I thought that was in for a hot second.

Sat 4 Jul 2026 at 1:15pm

By Chris De Silva

A lovely cross into the box from Juan Quintero and Davinson Sánchez rises up with the header.

It's on the mark, but Lawrence Ati-Zigi makes another good save and then gobbles up the rebound.

The margin remains at one goal... Ghana lurking ominously.

Sat 4 Jul 2026 at 1:14pm

By Chris De Silva

Carlos Queiroz has made another pair of changes as we tick into the final 10 minutes of normal time.

Jordan Ayew and Caleb Yirenkyi are taken off and are replaced by Ernest Nuamah and Prince Adu.

Sat 4 Jul 2026 at 1:12pm

By Chris De Silva

Juan Quintero stands over a dead ball around 30 yards out from goal and decides to go for goal, but this is a poor effort.

Quintero going for gold with his first touch of the ball since coming on.

Meanwhile, Alidu Seidu has picked up a yellow card for a rash challenge.

Sat 4 Jul 2026 at 1:09pm

By Chris De Silva

Richard Ríos has put in a couple of delicious balls into the penalty box since coming on for James Rodríguez.

He floats in another cross and Luis Díaz is waiting at the back post, but he's not able to make contact with the ball.

Sat 4 Jul 2026 at 1:07pm

By Chris De Silva

Jhon Arias's night is done as he his hooked for Juan Quintero.

Arias will hope that his goal will be enough to win it for Colombia.

Sat 4 Jul 2026 at 1:05pm

By Chris De Silva

Ghana starting to run out of time here in Kansas City, what have they got left in the kit bag?

Antoine Semenyo with another shot wide of the mark from long range.

Ghana has registered eight shots on goal for the match, but none have hit the target. They've had just six touches in the opposition box and have 0.24 xG.

That's simply not going to get it done.

Sat 4 Jul 2026 at 12:56pm

By Chris De Silva

Carlos Queiroz has made a couple of changes here with Iñaki Williams and Kwasi Sibo coming off.

They're replaced by Elisha Owusu and Abdul Fatawu.

Sat 4 Jul 2026 at 12:53pm

By Chris De Silva

Colombia misses another glorious chance to go up 2-0!

Another sweeping move sees Luis Díaz with another shot on goal, this time he's definitely onside, but he is denied by Lawrence Ati-Zigi, who makes an excellent save.

Díaz has to be wondering how he's not hit the scoreboard yet this evening.

Sat 4 Jul 2026 at 12:52pm

By Chris De Silva

Luis Díaz wheels away in celebration after tapping a cross into the back of the net, but it's chalked off!

That was a signature finish from the left-winger, one that we've seen him make plenty of times with both Bayern and Liverpool.

However, replays show that he was clearly offside.

Ghana will breathe a sigh of relief after a needless turnover led to the shot on goal

Sat 4 Jul 2026 at 12:48pm

By Chris De Silva

Ghana with their closest chance!

Antoine Semenyo fires in a very, very tempting low cross from the left side, but there's no one in the middle of the box and the ball drifts out of play.

Semenyo throws both his hands up in frustration. That was an excellent ball across the face of the goal.

Sat 4 Jul 2026 at 12:43pm

By Chris De Silva

Richard Ríos has his first shot on goal after replacing his captain and it's a decent one!

Ríos fires across the goal from the right side of the box and narrowly misses the left-hand upright.
